info.rent.step1.title: Visit the Nearest Partner Location
info.rent.step1.desc: Visit the nearest partner location via the 'Rental Locations' page on our website. ※ For off-campus locations, please check the operating hours!
info.rent.step2.title: Scan the QR code on the top or side of the umbrella handle

info.rent.step5.desc2: For smooth service operation, the maximum rental period is limited to 14 days.
info.return.step1.title: Visit the Nearest Partner Location
info.return.step1.desc: Visit the nearest partner location via the 'Rental Locations' page on our website. ※ You can return the umbrella at any partner location, not just where you rented it!
info.return.step2.title: Umbrella Return
info.return.step2.desc: Please return the umbrella to the umbrella storage box first!
info.return.step3.title: Scan the QR code of the umbrella storage box or rack
info.return.step3.desc: You must complete the return form submission to receive your deposit refund!
info.return.step4.title: Kakao Login & Auto-fill Return Info
info.return.step4.desc1: If you log in to Kakao, the umbrella information to return will be automatically completed :)
info.return.step4.desc2: Please double-check your refund account details!
info.return.step5.title: Deposit refunded after staff confirmation!
info.return.step5.desc1: Deposit refunds typically take 2–3 business days 😊
info.return.step5.desc2: During sudden rainy weather, high volume may cause slight delays — thank you for your patience!
info.faq.q1: Should the umbrella rental and return points match?
info.faq.a1: Rental and return locations do not need to match! Simply use the nearest partner location to you.
info.faq.q2: How do I check the opening hours?
info.faq.a2: On-campus locations at Yonsei University are available 24/7. For off-campus locations (cafes), you must visit during their operating hours. You can check hours by clicking on the location in the 'Rental Locations' page.
info.faq.q3: When will the guarantee payment be refunded?
info.faq.a3: It typically takes 2–3 business days. During sudden rainy weather, high rental/return volume may cause slight delays — we appreciate your understanding. For urgent inquiries, please reach out via UPbrella's Kakao Plus channel (search 'upbrella' in the Kakao search bar).
